# ramble Provider

Manage resources on a [Ramble](https://ramble.openwander.org) server, a registry for Nomad packs and jobs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "ramble" {
  # Defaults to https://ramble.openwander.org, or the RAMBLE_ADDR environment variable.
  address = "https://ramble.openwander.org"

  # Prefer the RAMBLE_TOKEN environment variable to keeping a token in configuration.
  token = var.ramble_token
}

variable "ramble_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Base URL of the Ramble server. May also be set with the `RAMBLE_ADDR` environment variable. Defaults to `https://ramble.openwander.org`. Must be `https`; plain `http` is accepted only for `localhost` and loopback addresses.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Ramble API token (`rmbl_...`) with write scope. May also be set with the `RAMBLE_TOKEN` environment variable. Required: the provider reports an error when it is configured without a token.
